task_definition.title: Milestone ζ: document milestone tasks in CLAUDE.md Task Routing
task_definition.description:
PRD: docs/prds/milestone-tasks.md task ζ. Depends on ε (document shipped, tested behaviour).

WHAT: Add a "Milestone tasks (dated / delayed)" subsection to the Task Routing section of CLAUDE.md, documenting the shipped feature:
- The metadata.milestone schema (mode: dated|delayed; dated → at ISO-8601; delayed → after_secs int>0).
- Orthogonality to task_kind: a milestone gates ANY task (normal agent, deterministic predicate, or pure human gate).
- The predicate exit-code contract (before_done.kind='predicate': rc==0 → done with deterministic-milestone provenance; rc!=0 → milestone_check_failed L2; script owns the threshold, orchestrator parses nothing).
- The frozen-once delayed-anchor semantics (timer starts when deps are satisfied; persisted wall-clock, survives restart; dispatch still re-checks live deps).
- The exemplar: a delayed deterministic predicate milestone ("one week after X lands, check flakiness < 5%, else escalate").

Modules touched: CLAUDE.md.

User-observable signal (docs leaf, roped to ε's shipped surface): CLAUDE.md documents the milestone metadata schema + the exit-code verdict contract + the delayed-anchor semantics.
Consumer: operators authoring milestone tasks (the CLAUDE.md Task Routing reference).
Substrate: the behaviour documented is delivered + tested by ε (upstream).
